comment: What the built store must contain, measured against the pinned versions in the manifest. Verification states the rules; this file states the data they are checked against, so a source changing shape under its pin shows up as an edit here rather than as a number buried in a check.

reasoning.comment: newPairs is what HermiT adds once the pairs any loaded source already asserts are subtracted; entailedPairs is what it derived before that subtraction. A source may legitimately add none, as MDO does. The chameo numbers are measured against the full EMMO closure (Phase 7): the no-EMMO build entailed 211. The chameo and emmo counts overlap by design, since each inferred graph stands alone: all 82 of emmo's new pairs also appear in chameo's 86, and the pairs only chameo contributes number 4. Sources in skipped must record in the catalogue why they were not reasoned.

browse.comment: Pages that must render particular content, chosen so that a silent regression in one of the harder paths shows up: subclass children, a SKOS-only tree, definition precedence, axiom verbalization, and the node cap on the graph export.

grounding.comment: The grounding route answers with definition text a caller can put in front of a reader. The term is one several sources define, so a single-source answer means the index has stopped spanning them.
